access.subtitle: Roles: {roles}. Tick what this vendor may do; anything beyond the role becomes a grant, anything removed from it a deny.

invoices.subtitleBuyer: Your invoices and what is outstanding.
invoices.subtitleStaff: Billing cycles, corrections and the clearance queue.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.subtitle: Running costs per vehicle; VAT recorded beside the net amount.

commissions.subtitle: What the platform earns on each booking. Exactly one GLOBAL rule is always active; category rules take precedence by priority.
